# Additional centroid and line boundary observations.

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 90 0, 180 0, -90 0)'))
=> "POINT(74.5829569088076 0)"

# The complement is the same region as POLYGON((0 0, 0 90, 90 0, 0 0)) with oriented => TRUE.
SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 90 0, 0 90, 0 0))')))
=> "POINT(-135 -35.2643896827547)"

SELECT ST_LINESUBSTRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0, 10 20)'), 0, 0.3333333333333333)
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)"

SELECT ST_LINESUBSTRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0, 10 20)'), 0.3333333333333333, 1)
=> "LINESTRING(10 0, 10 20)"

SELECT ST_LINESUBSTRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0, 10 20)'), 0.5, 0.50000000000001)
=> "POINT(10 5.0000000000003)"

SELECT ST_LINESUBSTRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0, 10 20)'), 0.5, 0.500000000001)
=> "LINESTRING(10 5, 10 5.00000000003)"

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(0 0)'), -1)
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: ST_LineInterpolatePoint: fraction should be between 0 and 1. Actual value was -1.000000; error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))'), 0.5)
=> error: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT: Argument to ST_LineInterpolatePoint must be a single line geography; an argument contained a polygon. Error in ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT expression

SELECT ST_LINESUBSTRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))'), 0, 1)
=> error: ST_LINESUBSTRING: Argument to STLineSubString must be a single line geography; an argument contained a polygon. Error in ST_LINESUBSTRING expression
